entries.title: Genesis 15:1
segments: ¶After these things, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Have no fear, Abram: I will keep you safe, and great will be your reward.

entries.title: Genesis 15:2
segments: ¶And Abram said, What will you give me? for I have no child and this Eliezer of Damascus will have all my wealth after me.

entries.title: Genesis 15:3
segments: And Abram said, You have given me no child, and a servant in my house will get the heritage.

entries.title: Genesis 15:4
segments: Then said the Lord, This man will not get the heritage, but a son of your body will have your property after you.

entries.title: Genesis 15:5
segments: And he took him out into the open air, and said to him, Let your eyes be lifted to heaven, and see if the stars may be numbered; even so will your seed be.

entries.title: Genesis 15:6
segments: And he had faith in the Lord, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

entries.title: Genesis 15:7
segments: ¶And he said to him, I am the Lord, who took you from Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land for your heritage.

entries.title: Genesis 15:8
segments: And he said, O Lord God, how may I be certain that it will be mine?

entries.title: Genesis 15:9
segments: And he said, Take a young cow of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a sheep of three years old, and a dove and a young pigeon.

entries.title: Genesis 15:10
segments: All these he took, cutting them in two and putting one half opposite the other, but not cutting the birds in two.

entries.title: Genesis 15:11
segments: And evil birds came down on the bodies, but Abram sent them away.

entries.title: Genesis 15:12
segments: ¶Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep came on Abram, and a dark cloud of fear.

entries.title: Genesis 15:13
segments: And he said to Abram, Truly, your seed will be living in a land which is not theirs, as servants to a people who will be cruel to them for four hundred years;

entries.title: Genesis 15:14
segments: But I will be the judge of that nation whose servants they are, and they will come out from among them with great wealth.

entries.title: Genesis 15:15
segments: As for you, you will go to your fathers in peace; at the end of a long life you will be put in your last resting-place.

entries.title: Genesis 15:16
segments: And in the fourth generation they will come back here; for at present the sin of the Amorite is not full.

entries.title: Genesis 15:17
segments: ¶Then when the sun went down and it was dark, he saw a smoking fire and a flaming light which went between the parts of the bodies.

entries.title: Genesis 15:18
segments: In that day the Lord made an agreement with Abram, and said, To your seed have I given this land from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

entries.title: Genesis 15:19
segments: The Kenite, the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,

entries.title: Genesis 15:20
segments: And the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,

entries.title: Genesis 15:21
segments: And the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
